type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Final commit: Implementation summary and complete Universe 00 v1.0.0
Complete Universe 00 implementation: Integration guide and README update
Phase 7 complete: Core documentation (Anchor Paper, Falsification, Millennium Protocol) and main Universe00 module
Phase 3 & 6 complete: Operators and Governance registry implemented
Phase 1-2 complete: Core modules and Laws implemented in Lean

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.LimitTheorems.first_limit_dominates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (r1 r2 : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r1) f = Outcome.limit r1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.LimitTheorems.limit_not_explosion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (ls : LimitState) : ∀ (a b : α), a ≠ b → ¬(Outcome.limit ls.reason = Outcome.value a ∧ Outcome.limit ls.reason = Outcome.value b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.LimitTheorems.limit_preserved_by_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (ls : LimitState) : Outcome.map f (Outcome.limit ls.reason) = Outcome.limit ls.reason

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.LimitTheorems.resolution_requires_declaration
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (ls : LimitState) (result : Outcome α) : result ≠ Outcome.limit ls.reason → ∃ (res : LimitResolution), res.limitState = ls

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.bind_assoc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (m : Outcome α) (f : α → Outcome β) (g : β → Outcome γ) : Outcome.bind (Outcome.bind m f) g = Outcome.bind m (fun x => Outcome.bind (f x) g)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.bind_limit_dominates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (r : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r) f = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.bind_pure_is_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → β) (m : Outcome α) : Outcome.bind m (fun a => Outcome.pure (f a)) = Outcome.map f m

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.bind_pure_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a : α) (f : α → Outcome β) : Outcome.bind (Outcome.pure a) f = f a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.bind_pure_right
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (m : Outcome α), Outcome.bind m Outcome.pure = m | Outcome.value _ => rfl | Outcome.limit _ => rfl

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.map_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → β) (r : LimitReason) : Outcome.map f (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.map_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → β) (a : α) : Outcome.map f (Outcome.value a) = Outcome.value (f a)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.OutcomeTheorems.no_explosion_from_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (r : LimitReason) (a : α) : Outcome.limit r ≠ Outcome.value a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.RegimeTheorems.reframe_identity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r : Regime) (o : Outcome α) : let trans

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.RegimeTheorems.reframe_preserves_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (trans : RegimeTransition) (a : α) : ∃ r, reframe trans (Outcome.value a) = Outcome.value a ∨ reframe trans (Outcome.value a) = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.RegimeTheorems.transition_requires_declaration
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r1 r2 : Regime) (o : Outcome α) : r1 ≠ r2 → ∃ (trans : RegimeTransition), trans.source = r1 ∧ trans.target = r2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.StatusTheorems.conjectural_isolation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (g : DependencyGraph) (proved conj : Statement) : proved.status.isProved → conj.status.isConjectural → ¬(conj.content ∈ proved.dependencies)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Core.StatusTheorems.proved_with_trusted_deps_is_trusted
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (stmt : Statement) (g : DependencyGraph) : stmt.status.isProved → (∀ dep ∈ stmt.dependencies, ∃ s ∈ g.statements, s.content = dep ∧ s.isTrusted) → g.getTrustLevel stmt.content = " " ∨ g.getTrustLevel stmt.content = " "

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.AntiAdHocTheorems.applied_regularizations_traceable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (reg : Regularization) (ls : LimitState) (v : α) : applyRegularization reg ls v ≠ Outcome.value v ∨ reg.status.isProved ∨ reg.status.isAssumed

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.AntiAdHocTheorems.regularization_has_method
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (reg : Regularization) : reg.method ≠ ""

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.AntiAdHocTheorems.regularization_has_status
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (reg : Regularization) : ∃ (s : ProofStatus), reg.status = s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ClassicalContrast.universe00_non_explosion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : Prop) (r : LimitReason) : ¬((Outcome.limit r : Outcome Prop) = Outcome.value p)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ConservativityTheorems.classical_no_explosion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (classical : α) (valid : Prop) : valid → ∀ (b : α), classical ≠ b → Outcome.value classical ≠ Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ConservativityTheorems.conservativity_implies_preservation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (classical : α) (valid : Prop) : valid → ∀ (f : α → α), ∃ (result : Outcome α), result = Outcome.map f (Outcome.value classical)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ConservativityTheorems.conservativity_regime_aware
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (classical : α) (regime : Regime) : regime = Regime.Classical → ∃ (result : Outcome α), result = Outcome.value classical

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ExplicitRegimeTheorems.laws_have_regime
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (law : Law) : ∃ (r : Regime), law.regime = r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ExplicitRegimeTheorems.operations_have_regime
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (op : RegimeAwareOperation α) : ∃ (r : Regime), op.regime = r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ExplicitRegimeTheorems.regime_awareness_explicit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (op : RegimeAwareOperation α) (r : Regime) : op.validInRegime r = true ∨ op.validInRegime r = false

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.ExplicitRegimeTheorems.theorems_have_regime
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (thm : ScopedTheorem) : ∃ (r : Regime), thm.regime = r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionProperties.limits_dont_contaminate
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (a b : α) : Outcome.value a ≠ Outcome.limit r → Outcome.value b ≠ Outcome.limit r → ∀ (f : α → α), Outcome.value (f a) ≠ Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionProperties.limits_isolated
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (a : α) : ∀ (f : Outcome α → Outcome α), f (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.limit r ∨ ∃ r', f (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.limit r'

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionProperties.non_explosion_preserved_by_bind
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : ∀ (b : β), Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r) f ≠ Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionProperties.non_explosion_preserved_by_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (r : LimitReason) : ∀ (b : β), Outcome.map f (Outcome.limit r) ≠ Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionTheorems.compatible_with_conservativity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (classical : α) (r : LimitReason) : Outcome.value classical ≠ Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionTheorems.compatible_with_preservation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : ∀ (b : β), Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r) f ≠ Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.NonExplosionTheorems.ensures_soundness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p q : Prop) (r : LimitReason) : (Outcome.limit r : Outcome Prop) ≠ Outcome.value p → (Outcome.limit r : Outcome Prop) ≠ Outcome.value q → ¬(p ∧ ¬p)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.PreservationTheorems.limits_are_sticky
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : ∀ (g : Outcome α → Outcome β), g (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r) f → g (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.PreservationTheorems.map_preserves_limit_property
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (o : Outcome α) : o.isLimit → (Outcome.map f o).isLimit

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.PreservationTheorems.no_arbitrary_choices
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (trigger : LimitTrigger) : ∀ (a : α), ¬∃ (h : Outcome α = Outcome.value a), (match trigger with | LimitTrigger.arbitraryChoice _ => True | _ => False)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.PreservationTheorems.preservation_transitive
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type u} (f : α → Outcome β) (g : β → Outcome γ) (r : LimitReason) : let comp

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.TraceabilityTheorems.assumed_has_id
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (claim : TraceableClaim) : claim.status.isAssumed → ∃ (id : String), claim.status.getReference = id

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.TraceabilityTheorems.proved_has_path
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (claim : TraceableClaim) : claim.status.isProved → ∃ (path : String), claim.status.getReference = path

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.TraceabilityTheorems.traceability_ensures_accountability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (claim : TraceableClaim) : claim.location ≠ ""

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.TraceabilityTheorems.traceable_has_status
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (claim : TraceableClaim) : ∃ (s : ProofStatus), claim.status = s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_not_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (classicalResult : α) (isClassicallyProved : Prop) : isClassicallyProved → ∀ (r : LimitReason), Outcome.value classicalResult ≠ Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_propagates_through_bind
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (f : α → Outcome β) : Outcome.bind (Outcome.limit r) f = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_propagates_through_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (r : LimitReason) : Outcome.map f (Outcome.limit r) = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_reason_preserved
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r : LimitReason) : ∀ (o : Outcome α), o = Outcome.limit r → o.getLimitReason = some r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.no_explosion_to_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r1 r2 : LimitReason) : r1 ≠ r2 → (Outcome.limit r1 : Outcome α) ≠ Outcome.limit r2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.no_explosion_to_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} (r : LimitReason) (a : α) : (Outcome.limit r : Outcome α) ≠ Outcome.value a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.compose_assoc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → Outcome β) (g : β → Outcome γ) (h : γ → Outcome δ) : ∀ (a : α), composeOp (composeOp f g) h a = composeOp f (composeOp g h) a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.filter_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : α → Bool) (r r' : LimitReason) : filter p r (Outcome.limit r') = Outcome.limit r'

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.filter_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : α → Bool) (r : LimitReason) (a : α) : filter p r (Outcome.value a) = if p a then Outcome.value a else Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.liftA2_limit_left
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → β → γ) (r : LimitReason) (ob : Outcome β) : liftA2 f (Outcome.limit r) ob = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.liftA2_limit_right
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : α → β → γ) (oa : Outcome α) (r : LimitReason) : liftA2 f oa (Outcome.limit r) = match oa with | Outcome.limit r' => Outcome.limit r' | Outcome.value _ => Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.recover_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : LimitReason → Outcome α) (r : LimitReason) : recover f (Outcome.limit r) = f r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.BasicTheorems.recover_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (f : LimitReason → Outcome α) (a : α) : recover f (Outcome.value a) = Outcome.value a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.ClassicalComparison.universe00_more_explicit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} [Field α] [DecidableEq α] (a : α) : ∃ r, universe00Div a 0 = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDecisionTheorems.decidable_has_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : Prop) [Decidable p] : ∃ b, decideOutcome p = Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDecisionTheorems.decision_respects_equivalence
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p q : Prop) [Decidable p] [Decidable q] (h : p ↔ q) : decideOutcome p = decideOutcome q

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDecisionTheorems.undecidable_has_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (prob : DecisionProblem) (h : ¬prob.isDecidable) : ∃ r, solveDecisionProblem prob = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDivisionTheorems.sdiv_nonzero_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a b : α) (h : b ≠ 0) : sdivClassical a b = Outcome.value (a / b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDivisionTheorems.sdiv_preserves_mul
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a b c : α) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) : liftA2 (· * ·) (sdivClassical a b) (sdivClassical a c) = Outcome.value ((a / b) * (a / c))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDivisionTheorems.sdiv_total_meadow
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a b : α) : ∃ c, sdivMeadow a b = Outcome.value c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.SafeDivisionTheorems.sdiv_zero_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a : α) : ∃ r, sdivClassical a 0 = Outcome.limit r

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Operators.sdivIFramework_is_regularization
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type u} [Field α] [DecidableEq α] (I : α) (h : I * 0 = 0) : ∀ a b, ∃ c, sdivIFramework I h a b = Outcome.value c ∨ sdivIFramework I h a b = Outcome.limit LimitReason.divisionByZero ∨ sdivIFramework I h a b = Outcome.limit (LimitReason.structuralBoundary " ")
